# gitmoap_group_push_rules (Data Source)

Get push rules for a group (raw values, no inheritance resolution). The rules this group sets itself, each absent where it leaves the rule to the groups above, and whether they are enforced on everything beneath. Anyone who can see the group may read them.

The token needs `push_rule:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_group_by_path" "acme" {
  full_path = "acme"
}

data "gitmoap_group_push_rules" "acme" {
  group_id = data.gitmoap_group_by_path.acme.group_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Group ID

### Read-Only

- `author_email_regex` (String)
- `commit_message_regex` (String)
- `enforcement` (String) Whether the scopes beneath may replace a rule, or only strengthen it.
- `max_file_size_mb` (Number)
- `prohibited_file_names_regex` (String)
- `reject_unsigned_commits` (Boolean)
- `require_closing_issue_reference` (Boolean)
- `require_issue_reference` (Boolean)
